name: Visco Arcade 2
summary:
Visco Arcade 2 cartridge for Evercade brings 8 more arcade classics from Japanese developer Visco, focusing on the later titles from their catalogue:

- Drift Out '94: The Hard Order — A follow-up to the original Drift Out, putting players back behind the wheel for more high-speed top-down rally racing.
- Neo Drift Out: New Technology — A Neo Geo-era sequel in the Drift Out series, offering a full world rally challenge.
- Breakers — A colourful 2D fighting game where players choose a warrior and battle for martial arts supremacy.
- Battle Flip Shot — A sports title that reimagines table tennis with vibrant characters and special attack moves.
- Bang Bead — The sequel to Battle Flip Shot, adding more technical court-based gameplay variations.
- Captain Tomaday — A "cute 'em up" shoot 'em up starring a tomato-powered hero taking to the skies.
- Ganryu — A hack-and-slash platformer based on Japanese legend, with relentless side-scrolling action.
- Bang² Busters — A colourful elimination platformer following Lazy and Refia against the forces of Emperor Honey.
